name: REX American Resources Corporation
tagline: Leading ethanol producer with strategic investments in renewable energy and carbon sequestration
hero_kpi_rationale: Bénéfice net en hausse de 43% à 83 millions de dollars en 2025, reflétant l'amélioration des marges de crush grâce aux crédits d'impôt 45Z et la volatilité favorable des prix des matières premières

kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to REX common shareholders
kpis.signal: Strong profitability growth driven by 45Z tax credits and favorable commodity spreads
kpis.description: REX reported net income of 83.0 million in fiscal 2025 compared to 58.2 million in fiscal 2024, a 43% increase benefiting from reductions in effective tax rate due to 45Z tax credits earned from ethanol production
10-K reports gross profit was higher in fiscal 2025 than 2024 primarily due to higher crush spreads, but specific dollar amounts are not disclosed

kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures for plant expansion, CI reduction, and carbon sequestration projects
kpis.signal: Modest capital expenditure decrease reflecting completion of certain One Earth projects
kpis.description: Capital expenditures totaled 68.4 million in fiscal 2025 versus 71.3 million in fiscal 2024, primarily at One Earth including plant expansion and CI reduction projects (43.7 million) and carbon sequestration (3.0 million)

kpis.explanation: Net cash provided by operating activities
kpis.signal: Strong improvement in operating cash generation year-over-year
kpis.description: Net cash provided by operating activities was 117.8 million for fiscal 2025 compared to 64.2 million for fiscal 2024, reflecting higher net income and improved working capital management
